text.en: The Jaintia kingdom linked hill and plain centres. [[nartiang|Nartiang]] in the hills and [[jaintiapur|Jaintiapur]] near Sylhet belong to this history; modern national borders cut across that older landscape.

text.en: Much later, [[sarbananda-singha|Sarbananda Singha]] built a Matak centre at [[bengmara|Bengmara]], associated with present-day Tinsukia. These communities and centres belong to different episodes, not one timeless list of tribes.
text.as: বহু পিছত [[sarbananda-singha|সৰ্বানন্দ সিংহ]]ই আজিৰ তিনিচুকীয়াৰ সৈতে জড়িত [[bengmara|বেংমৰা]]ত মটক কেন্দ্ৰ গঢ়ে। জনগোষ্ঠী আৰু কেন্দ্ৰবোৰ বেলেগ ঘটনাৰ; যুগহীন একে তালিকা নহয়।
